resources.string: Rock-ships called Drifters fly along the glowing lanes toward your Core. If enough of them get through, the Core falls.
Tap an empty node to build a bot. Picket shoots all round, Lobber hits groups from far away, Haze reaches a long way, Tender slows and freezes, and Skiff patrols the edge.
Tap a bot to upgrade it up to level five, change who it aims at, or sell it for most of your Scrap back.
Aegis adds a shield to the Core. Specials drop every few waves and from Couriers: Nova Pulse clears the screen and Repair Kit heals the Core.
Pause whenever you like and keep building. Every tenth wave brings a boss, so save a Special for it. Up to four people can play on one device.
A space station that drifts in orbit stays up only because it keeps falling around the planet, never quite reaching it.
